instruction: A candid wide-angle photograph captures an indoor motion capture studio featuring white walls and a red carpeted floor. On the left side of the frame, the woman in the white t-shirt and blue jeans (R2) stands in profile facing towards the right. On the right, the man in the dark polo shirt and blue shorts (R1) stands facing her, leaning his upper body forward to extend his hand and touch her chest. In the background, tripods and electronic equipment are visible against the walls. Bright overhead lighting evenly illuminates the scene, casting soft shadows on the red carpet.
